newsitem.title: USA: Material Sciences complies with covenants.
newsitem.headline: Material Sciences complies with covenants.

text.p: Material Sciences Corp said Thursday it is in compliance with all financial covenants under its borrowing arrangements.
The company said in a statement it has received full support of its lenders with no changes in its ability to borrow under all existing bank credit facilities.

On Monday, the company said its preliminarily adjusted fiscal 1997 earnings were $1.03 per share, below the consensus estimates of $1.17 per share. Earlier, it said accounting irregularities at one of its subsidiaries caused it to overstate operating earnings starting in late fiscal 1995.

Also earlier Thursday, the law firms of Stull, Stull & Brady and Weiss & Yourman gave notice of a class-action lawsuit filed in Illinois federal court against Material Sciences and its former chief financial officer, alleging violations of securities law.
Company officials declined to comment on the suit.
Material Sciences shares were off 1/8 at 13-3/8.
